canonicalDependencyPath.description: AURACORE-AUTOLOOP-C5B-ATOMIC-EVIDENCE-SCHEMA-PARITY-AND-CANONICAL-TEST-RUNNER-1: exactly one lexical form per repository-relative dependency path — mirrors validate-role-artifacts.mjs isCanonicalDependencyPath() exactly (proven by an exhaustive fuzz-parity test, not just the enumerated required cases). Repository-relative, '/'-separated, no leading '/', no leading './', no trailing '/', no repeated '/', no '.' or '..' path component, no backslash, no glob characters ('*','?','[',']'), no NUL, no leading/trailing whitespace, no Windows drive prefix. Ambiguous input is REJECTED, never silently normalized.

mode.description: Fable5 default workflow is READ_ONLY, CHANGE, OPS. IMPLEMENT/FIX/VERIFY_ONLY/MAP_ONLY/READ_ONLY_DISCOVERY/READ_ONLY_DESIGN are legacy compatibility aliases, not card-generation defaults. COMMIT_ONLY, PUSH_ONLY, and SEAL_ONLY are exception-only per AGENTS.md Governance Constitution rule 12; each requires explicit Controller authorization and a concrete reason.

start_head.description: Bounded repair Finding A: mirrors run-card.mjs validateCardInput()'s start_head check (the runtime authority — see run-card.mjs comment at the validation function, design §32.16 / Gate A finding: this schema is documentation/parity, not itself enforced at runtime).

risk.description: Optional risk tier. HIGH triggers strict reviewer routing.

model.description: Must be in the DeepSeek executor allowlist. Currently: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro.

auto.description: DEPRECATED in v0. --auto is HARDCODED OFF for executor and reviewer. Setting auto=true has NO effect; the runner prints a NOTE and proceeds without --auto.

default.description: External reviewer model. Must be GPT (external review only). DeepSeek executor models are FORBIDDEN as reviewer.

invoke_real_model.description: DEPRECATED. The real-invocation gate is harness.invoke_real_models (plural). This singular field is IGNORED.

oneOf.description: Legacy command string. Runtime (validateRequiredCommandsContract) rejects an empty or whitespace-only string via String.prototype.trim().length === 0 — minLength:1 alone would accept a whitespace-only string, so 'pattern' additionally requires at least one non-whitespace character, matching trim() semantics exactly. Leading/trailing whitespace around otherwise-non-empty command text is NOT rejected by runtime and is therefore NOT rejected here.

required_commands.description: AURACORE-AUTOLOOP-C5B1: array entries are either a legacy command string (unchanged) or a structured object with an explicit id/scope/paths. Exactly two dependency scopes exist: 'global' (repository-wide) and 'paths' (explicit path-scoped metadata). C5B1 validates and normalizes structured entries but does not skip execution based on scope/paths — every required command still runs in every validation pass and at the independent final barrier, in declared array order. See card-input.schema.json.C5B1 note below and run-card.mjs validateCardInput()/normalizeRequiredCommand().

subprocess_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock cap for `opencode run` subprocess. Default 10 minutes. Timeout → HOLD, never PASS.
